findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "africa-scam-check" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: africa_scams.check_message, africa_scams.list_patterns · Private data: africa_scams.check_message, africa_scams.where_to_report · Public sink: africa_scams.check_message, africa_scams.where_to_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: africa_scams.check_message, africa_scams.list_patterns · Private data: africa_scams.check_message, africa_scams.where_to_report · Public sink: africa_scams.check_message, africa_scams.where_to_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
